meta.title: Funding sources watched for new rounds and notices
meta.method: Read by scripts/audit/funding_watch.py, daily from .github/workflows/chfa-qap-watch.yml. Every program's own page is taken from the two catalogs (data/policy/co-developer-funding-guide.json official_url; data/policy/soft-funding-status.json source_url or contactUrl), so a program added there is watched on the next run without an entry here. This file adds what the catalogs do not hold: each agency's own announcement and funding-opportunity pages, including infrastructure programs that can support housing but are not yet in the guide, and the federal searches. A watched page that changes opens an issue; it never changes a program's status. A person reads the agency's page and updates the record with a quote. Each URL below answered HTTP 200 with the title given on 2026-10-15 (the award and newsroom pages added on 2026-10-16) unless its note says otherwise.

agency_pages.title: Division of Housing Funding Opportunities | Division of Housing
agency_pages.why: DOH's own funding page, which says it lists "requests for proposals, applications, and notices of funding availabilities". (doh.colorado.gov/funding-opportunities, first listed here, is a narrower page; corrected 2026-10-15 after review.)

agency_pages.title: Funding Opportunities | Division of Local Government
agency_pages.why: Local-government grants, including infrastructure and planning money that can unlock housing sites.

agency_pages.title: Energy/Mineral Impact Assistance Fund Grant (EIAF)
agency_pages.why: Energy/Mineral Impact Assistance Fund (EIAF): grants to local governments for public facilities, including water, sewer and roads. On 2026-10-15 the page read "Future cycles will be announced and are dependent on severance and federal mineral lease revenues."

agency_pages.title: Energy/Mineral Impact Assistance Fund Program Awards
agency_pages.why: Final EIAF awards for the last three cycles; a new list means a cycle has been decided.

agency_pages.title: Strong Communities | Division of Local Government
agency_pages.why: Infrastructure and Strong Communities grants for infill infrastructure that supports housing.

agency_pages.title: Community Development Block Grant - Public Facilities | Division of Local Government
agency_pages.why: Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) public facilities money for non-entitlement towns and counties, which can pay for water, sewer and street work.

agency_pages.title: Proposition 123 - Colorado Affordable Housing Financing Fund
agency_pages.why: Prop 123 Affordable Housing Financing Fund (AHFF) programs: land banking, concessionary debt and equity.

agency_pages.title: Housing Programs | Colorado Office of Economic Development and International Trade
agency_pages.why: OEDIT's housing programs, including the Innovative Housing Incentive Program and Prop 123 announcements.

agency_pages.title: CHFA: CHFA Newsroom
agency_pages.why: CHFA award announcements and new programs (the tax-credit plan itself is watched separately by chfa_qap_watch.py).

agency_pages.agency: Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment (CDPHE)
agency_pages.title: Water quality grants and loans | Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment
agency_pages.why: State Revolving Fund (SRF) loans and grants for drinking water and wastewater systems, the capacity new housing needs.

agency_pages.agency: Colorado Water Resources and Power Development Authority (CWRPDA)
agency_pages.title: Programs - Colorado Water Resources and Power Development Authority
agency_pages.why: CWRPDA finances the State Revolving Funds and its own water and wastewater loan programs.

agency_pages.title: USDA Rural Development Colorado
agency_pages.why: Rural housing (Section 515, 538) and Water and Waste Disposal loans and grants. Answered HTTP 403 to a scripted request on 2026-10-15; if GitHub's runners are blocked too, the watch reports it unverifiable and asks for a check by hand.

agency_pages.title: Application Schedule and Awards
agency_pages.why: Division of Housing application deadlines and State Housing Board award results; a new line means a round opened or was decided.

agency_pages.title: Private Activity Bonds
agency_pages.why: DOH's private activity bond index, which links each year's direct allocations page; a new year's link means new bond cap has been given to local issuers for 4% housing deals.

agency_pages.title: The Colorado State Affordable Housing Support Fund: Proposition 123
agency_pages.why: DOLA's Prop 123 home page: local commitments, filings and program updates.

agency_pages.title: Proposition 123 Funding Opportunities
agency_pages.why: DOLA's Prop 123 programs and their rounds; a new line means a round opened or changed.

agency_pages.title: Public Information Center and Newsroom
agency_pages.why: DOLA press releases, where State Housing Board and grant awards are announced.

agency_pages.title: Selected Applicants - Proposition 123: Affordable Housing Financing Fund
agency_pages.why: Archive of Affordable Housing Financing Fund awards and selections by fiscal year and program; a new entry means a round was decided.

agency_pages.title: News
agency_pages.why: OEDIT press releases, where Prop 123 and housing program awards are announced.

agency_pages.title: CHFA: Applicant and Award Reports
agency_pages.why: Housing tax credit applicant and award reports; a new report means a round's applicants or awards were posted.

grants_gov.why: Federal notices of funding opportunity (NOFOs), forecasted or posted, that Colorado agencies, local governments or developers could use for housing or the infrastructure it needs.

federal_register.why: Funding notices published in the Federal Register by the agencies that fund housing and the water, sewer and broadband it needs. A full-text search alone returned mostly information-collection notices on 2026-10-15, so results are kept only when the title names a funding notice.
federal_register.title_pattern: notice of funding|funding opportunit|funding availability|allocation availability|funding round

program_searches.why: USDA Rural Development's own pages answer HTTP 403 to every automated read (checked 2026-10-18 with three different clients). Section 515 rounds, the Section 538 notice and their fee and rule changes are all published in the Federal Register, so this search stands in for those pages. Titles here need not name a funding round: a fee or loan-to-cost change is news for these programs.

covered_elsewhere.why: Every rd.usda.gov page answers HTTP 403 to automated reads, including robots.txt (checked 2026-10-18). The Federal Register carries Rural Development's funding notices (Rural Housing Service, Rural Utilities Service) and the multifamily program notices and rules, so while those searches answer, a blocked rd.usda.gov page is not a check-by-hand item. The pages are still fetched daily and compared again the day they answer.
